proof_spine: Choose one common epsilon and one nearby sample radius for both derivative estimates.
Treat the difference quotient at that sample as one mathematical atom.
Apply the triangle inequality and derive the strict self-bound contradiction.

blocks.intent: Give the three repeated analytic objects role-based typed local names.

attempts.candidate:
thm derivative_value_unique:
    ? forall f fn(t R) R, x0, slope1, slope2 R:
        $has_derivative_at(f, x0, slope1)
        $has_derivative_at(f, x0, slope2)
        =>:
            slope1 = slope2
    by contra:
        ? slope1 = slope2
        slope1 != slope2
        slope1 - slope2 != 0
        abs(slope1 - slope2) > 0
        abs(slope1 - slope2) / 3 $in R+
        have epsilon R+ = abs(slope1 - slope2) / 3
        obtain delta1 from exist delta1 R+ st {$derivative_delta_controlled(f, x0, slope1, epsilon, delta1)}
        obtain delta2 from exist delta2 R+ st {$derivative_delta_controlled(f, x0, slope2, epsilon, delta2)}
        finite_set_min(union({delta1}, {delta2})) $in R+
        have radius R+ = finite_set_min(union({delta1}, {delta2}))
        radius / 2 $in R+
        have sample R = x0 + radius / 2
        sample = x0 + radius / 2 > x0
        sample != x0
        sample - x0 = radius / 2
        sample - x0 > 0
        abs(sample - x0) = sample - x0 = radius / 2
        abs(sample - x0) = radius / 2 < radius <= delta1
        abs(sample - x0) = radius / 2 < radius <= delta2
        have difference_quotient R = (f(sample) - f(x0)) / (sample - x0)
        abs(difference_quotient - slope1) < epsilon
        abs(difference_quotient - slope2) < epsilon
        abs(slope1 - difference_quotient) = abs(difference_quotient - slope1)
        slope1 - slope2 = (slope1 - difference_quotient) + (difference_quotient - slope2)
        abs(slope1 - slope2) = abs((slope1 - difference_quotient) + (difference_quotient - slope2)) <= abs(slope1 - difference_quotient) + abs(difference_quotient - slope2)
        abs(slope1 - difference_quotient) + abs(difference_quotient - slope2) < epsilon + epsilon = 2 * epsilon
        2 / 3 < 1
        (2 / 3) * abs(slope1 - slope2) < 1 * abs(slope1 - slope2)
        2 * epsilon = 2 * abs(slope1 - slope2) / 3 = (2 / 3) * abs(slope1 - slope2)
        1 * abs(slope1 - slope2) = abs(slope1 - slope2)
        2 * epsilon < abs(slope1 - slope2)
        abs(slope1 - slope2) <= abs(slope1 - difference_quotient) + abs(difference_quotient - slope2) < 2 * epsilon < abs(slope1 - slope2)
        impossible abs(slope1 - slope2) < abs(slope1 - slope2)
